title: Strategy frontmatter (finance/strategy.md)
description: The user's current financial working mode and their journey state. Mode is a starting point, not a lifetime setting (D2a): envelope adoption can be partial and per-category.

mode.description: Overall stance: awareness (shame-free visibility), envelopes (full allocation), hybrid (partial adoption in progress).

envelope_adoption.description: Per-category envelope adoption; presence of entries with mode=awareness implies a journey in progress.

envelope.description: Envelope id from accounts.md this category draws from.

next_review.description: When the coaching layer should next revisit the mode with the user.

language.description: BCP-47 tag for user-facing dialogue and reports (D6). Default en.
